hard_fail_reasons: The fit and finish improve in the latest captures, but the doors and crown still use broad flat-faced components with limited crafted profile. The approved transfer gate requires more than the current material improvement; the family is not ready for production promotion.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with v002, v003 materially improves the timber color and directional grain, and the integrated room captures retain the full asset at gameplay distance. The latest detail capture now frames the full crown and plinth. However, the door panels, carcass and moulding remain flat component meshes, while the target has more varied carved profiles, grain and physically detailed hinges. No stable production incumbent exists, so v003 remains a best-current review candidate rather than a replacement.
next_action_hypothesis: Backlog this asset after its three approved-target attempts. Resume only with a production mesh workflow that authors shaped casework, turned or curved members, credible fitted joints and target-specific proportions; avoid another material-only loop.
